ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Weeping Stones
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WEEPINGSTONES_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 Phase A (biome_mod_architecture.md §5) — this mod now carries `RM_WeepingStones`, the franchise-free BiomeDef itself, as its own standalone RimMandrake mod. The campaign twin `RUT_WeepingStones` (src/RimUtinni/ UtinniPatches/Defs/BiomeDefs/RUT_WeepingStones.xml) is FROZEN and keeps carrying the live Ash'karr world until the terminal paint (BIOME_PAINT_ONCE_AT_THE_END_1) — this mod's own copy is not yet on any live tile, which is the expected mid-migration state, not a defect.
The BiomeDef ships with its franchise-free content only: `ColossusToad` (vanilla Odyssey) and `AA_Eyeling` (Alpha Animals, non-Star-Wars donor) in `wildAnimals`; `Plant_Reeds`, `AB_GreenRockFern`, `RUT_Dewshrooms` (shared with The Rot's kit, inline via `mandrake.rut.rotsporekit`) and `Plant_Ambrosia` in `wildPlants`; the fish bestiary (`RM_Ikkal`/`RM_Tarrik`/`RM_Duul`/`RM_Ullo`/`RM_Ozhu`/`RM_Vobbal`/`RM_SeepStone`, each a duplicate of the frozen twin's own `RUT_` items so both keep resolving independently); its own `RM_BiomeWorker_WeepingStones` in place of the donor `VanillaBiomes.BiomeWorker_ DesertOasis` (a donor type in `workerClass` is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume); and the water-truce `modExtensions` block (`RM_WaterTruceExtension`, radius 10, `mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards`) carried over from the twin. `generatesNaturally` is false — this biome is placed by hand (Oasis landmark authoring), never natural worldgen, so its `workerClass` exists to satisfy the field rather than to compete on the tile-scoring pass.
The 8 Star Wars donor fauna the twin's own `wildAnimals` carried inline (`mlie. starwarsanimalcollection`'s Ollopom/Fanback/Dewback/Boma/Dactillion/Bantha/Eopie/Jamel) do NOT ride this def — they ride a Utinni patch instead (`src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_WeepingStones.xml`, cast as their existing `RSW_` ports), per Q11 (`SW_FAUNA_NEVER_IN_RM_TIER_1`): Star Wars content stays in the campaign tier, never the RimMandrake one.
⛔ **Owed, not shipped this wave**: the 10 invented fauna and the flora-roster additions ruled at `WEEPING_STONES_DESIGN_SITTING_1` (2026-09-24) — RM_Vellak, RM_Kirruk, RM_Vhakk, RM_Tirbak, RM_Burrak, RM_Ssurr, RM_Sillik, RM_Mirrik, plus RM_Dewblade/RM_Weepmat/ RM_Verdimoss/RM_Shadefern/RM_Bladderquill/RM_Salvecomb/RM_Rockfinger/RM_Dripfringe/ RM_Steamfrond/RM_Dewgourd and the canyon-filling crab adapted from AA_SummitCrab — are RULED and recorded in `rosters/weeping_stones.json`'s `fauna`/`flora`/`new_defs` arrays, but none has a ThingDef yet; authoring that full cast is content work at `STOCKED_POOL_BUILD_1`'s own scale and ships in a following wave, not invented here. `RM_Shadefern` replacing `AB_GreenRockFern` is therefore NOT yet applied to the BiomeDef above — the donor stays wired until its replacement actually exists.
Original description, kept below for the STOCKED_POOL_BUILD_1 content this mod already carries (the Stocked Pool bestiary/cuisine, unwired to any BiomeDef's live spawn lists until the husbandry loop lands — see that build's own wave note):
STOCKED_POOL_BUILD_1 (owner typed 2026-09-24, on `WEEPING_STONES_FISH_HUSBANDRY_1`: "love it. Moisture farmers specializing in fish. Ripe possibilities for rimcuisine stuff too. Make the fish nasty and way too active. And some shouldn't be fish but alien beasts you really wonder if we should be eating.")
This mod is the Weeping Stones' STOCKED line, in the RM_ (RimMandrake) tier: franchise-free, invented names only (Q11a), rich enough to stand alone with no Star Wars dependency. It is distinct from the WILD catch (the ruled gentle six wild fish, unchanged) — nastiness is what domestication and crowding do; the pen makes the monster, never the shore.
The bestiary: `RM_Murrin` (the gentle baseline), four "nasty and way too active" fish (`RM_Skarrin` the ring-breaker jumper, `RM_Karrek` the swarm-flenser, `RM_Vizhik` the traveling pot-eel, `RM_Vhorrin` the mismanagement state made flesh), and three catches that are not fish at all (`RM_Loomu` the caller, `RM_Huldu` the warm one, `RM_Ivvol` the tally) — the best eating in the biome, and nobody eats them comfortably.
Cuisine hooks: six recipes/ingredients including a real doubt-meat mood economy — per-beast "Ate X" thoughts (loomu/huldu/ivvol), graded by callousness/psychopathy, diluted in mixed meals, undiluted in the named roast.
**Build state (2026-09-24, wave 1):** the bestiary (pawn race + PawnKindDef pairs) and the cuisine layer (meat items, recipes, doubt-meat ThoughtDefs) ship this wave. The husbandry LOOP — pen zone designator, per-pool-body `RM_MapComponent_PoolStock` bookkeeping (stealing `RM_LiquidBody`'s region logic), ring-density READ overlay art, handler-injury toil failures, vizhik escape events, and the vhorrin cull set-piece — is the honest hard part and ships in a following wave. None of these species are wired into the live `RUT_WeepingStones` BiomeDef's `wildAnimals`/`fishTypes` yet: that wiring waits on `WEEPINGSTONES_RM_MOD_BUILD_1` landing the `RM_WeepingStones` BiomeDef this mod's content is meant to populate. Until both land, this mod ships inert defs with no spawn path — degrades clean, breaks nothing.
**Mod Settings** (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine): a master "Stocked pools enabled" toggle, off by default until the husbandry loop ships, so enabling this mod today changes nothing about a running game. When the loop lands the toggle gates the whole mechanism; wild fishing (the ruled gentle six) is never touched by it.
